name: ask-models
description: Consult other AI models for a second opinion via orchestration-friendly CLI wrappers: Claude Opus (ask-claude), OpenAI Codex/GPT (ask-codex), any Cursor-hosted model (ask-cursor), and Google's Antigravity/Gemini (ask-antigravity). Start partners in the background, watch their JSONL event stream live to tell thinking from hung, then collect clean final results.
